title: The Last Recipe
author: Cyrus Hartwell
blurb: Rafael Zhou, the eldest sibling raising the younger ones while mom works nights, has spent twenty years being so careful it hurts. Then grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must save the tradition that made the town, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
